sentences.en: In their best case, they build a strong case against the president.

sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将与现在支持弹劾的一位众议院新晋议员交谈，

sentences.zh: 我在周二下午与谢里尔议员进行了交谈，就在佩洛西议长宣布启动弹劾调查前不久。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine this feels like a pretty historic day in your office and in your chamber of Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不想象，在你的办公室和你的国会众议院里，这感觉像是一个相当具有历史意义的日子。

sentences.en: It does feel like a historic day.
sentences.zh: 这确实感觉像是一个历史性的日子。

sentences.en: It does feel important, but I am hoping that we can, after today, get back to the reasons that I'm really here to legislate on health care and taxes and infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 这确实很重要，但我希望在今天之后，我们能回到我真正来这里的目的，即就医疗保健、税收和基础设施进行立法。

sentences.en: Well, but this conversation is going to be about impeachment with apologies because
sentences.zh: 好吧，但这次谈话将围绕弹劾展开，请原谅因为

sentences.en: No, certainly.
sentences.zh: 不，当然。

sentences.en: after months and months of saying that you don't think impeachment is the right step, you have released a statement saying that you're open to the possibility that it is.
sentences.zh: 在数月来一直表示你认为弹劾不是正确的步骤之后，你发表了一份声明，称你对这种可能性持开放态度。

sentences.en: So let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: To start, I wonder if you could read from the statement that you released on Monday night about this.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想知道你是否可以朗读一下你周一晚上就此发布的声明中的内容。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We are now faced with accusations from numerous sources that our president attempted to pressure
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临来自多个来源的指控，称我们的总统试图施压

sentences.en: a foreign government to investigate one of his rivals in the next presidential election.
sentences.zh: 一个外国政府去调查他在下届总统大选中的竞争对手之一。

sentences.en: In other words, the president of the United States is attempting to fix the election.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，美利坚合众国总统正试图操纵选举。

sentences.en: I think these accusations should be addressed with all of the tools at Congress's disposal, including articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我认为应该动用国会掌握的所有工具来处理这些指控，包括弹劾条款。

sentences.en: I did not run for Congress to impeach the president.
sentences.zh: 我竞选国会议员不是为了弹劾总统。

sentences.en: I ran to make the lives of New Jerseyans better.
sentences.zh: 我参选是为了让新泽西州人民的生活变得更好。

sentences.en: But I have long said that Congress is a co-equal branch of government and has constitutional oversight duties, as well as duties to legislate for Americans.
sentences.zh: 但我长期以来一直认为，国会是政府中平等的部门之一，拥有宪法规定的监督职责，以及为美国人立法的职责。

sentences.en: The president of the United States is threatening our national security.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国总统正在威胁我们的国家安全。

sentences.en: I believe it is my responsibility as a member of Congress to ensure that I protect our country from any and all threats.
sentences.zh: 我认为作为一名国会议员，我的责任是确保保护我们的国家免受任何和所有威胁。

sentences.en: And that is what I intend to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我打算做的。

sentences.en: I can't imagine that you made this decision lightly.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象你做出这个决定是轻率的。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what happened in the lead up to your decision to release this statement and an op-ed you released with six other moderate Democratic colleagues from the House.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈在你决定发表这份声明以及你与来自众议院的其他六位温和派民主党同僚共同发表的一篇专栏文章之前发生了什么。

sentences.en: Tell me about those conversations that you were having with those colleagues, if you would, that led to this decision to come out together as you did.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，请告诉我你与这些同僚进行的那些对话，正是这些对话导致了你们像这样共同站出来的决定。

sentences.en: And so all of us, as military veterans and CIA officers, have been trained to make hard decisions in tough circumstances.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们所有人作为退伍军人和中情局官员，都受过在艰难环境中做出艰难决策的训练。

sentences.en: But this wasn't one of those.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是其中之一。

sentences.en: This wasn't a tough decision for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说不是一个艰难的决定。

sentences.en: This was sort of an obvious decision.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是显而易见的决定。

sentences.en: And someone asked me earlier, well, who led on this?
sentences.zh: 刚才有人问我，嗯，是谁带头做这件事的？

sentences.en: Nobody led on this.
sentences.zh: 没有人带头。

sentences.en: We're all in a chat group.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一个聊天群里。

sentences.en: We all text back and forth routinely.
sentences.zh: 我们经常互相发信息。

sentences.en: And when this news came out, we started talking and saying, this is a huge issue.
sentences.zh: 当这个消息出来时，我们开始讨论并说，这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: This is a national security issue.
sentences.zh: 这是一个国家安全问题。

sentences.en: This is different from what we've seen before.
sentences.zh: 这与我们以前看到的不同。

sentences.en: And we need to act.
sentences.zh: 我们需要采取行动。

sentences.en: And because we all felt the same way about this and we all saw the national security implications, we thought it would be best to act as a group.
sentences.zh: 因为我们对此有相同的看法，并且我们都看到了国家安全的影响，所以我们认为以集体形式行动是最好的。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, the hardest part of all this was getting seven Congress people to agree on the language of the op-ed.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这一切中最难的部分是让七位国会议员就专栏文章的措辞达成一致。

sentences.en: We had people putting commas in and taking commas out.
sentences.zh: 我们有人加逗号，也有人删逗号。

sentences.en: So that was probably the hardest part of all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是所有事情中最难的部分。

sentences.en: I'm quite surprised to hear you say that this wasn't a tough decision.
sentences.zh: 听到你说这不是一个艰难的决定，我感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: You represent purple districts, swing districts.
sentences.zh: 你们代表的是摇摆选区，两党争夺激烈的选区。

sentences.en: And so it feels like inherently it's a very tough decision in the sense that it may not represent the will of the majority of your constituents.
sentences.zh: 因此，从本质上讲，这感觉是一个非常艰难的决定，因为它可能并不代表你们选区多数选民的意愿。

sentences.en: I think it would be a tough decision if this was in some way a political decision.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果这在某种程度上是一个政治决定，那它就会是一个艰难的决定。

sentences.en: But for all of us, it's always been about what is the best decision for this country.
sentences.zh: 但对我们所有人来说，这始终关乎什么是对这个国家最好的决定。

sentences.en: And I've often said, you know, if I look back on this in 10 years or 20 years, how is our country going to be on better footing because of a decision I made today?
sentences.zh: 我经常说，你知道，如果我在10年或20年后回看这件事，我们的国家会因为我今天做出的决定而处于更有利的地位吗？

sentences.en: And so when you have that as your compass, then a decision like this and seeing the threat to our
sentences.zh: 所以，当你把这作为你的指南针时，像这样的决定，看到对我们

sentences.en: national security and seeing these grave breaches, the flagrant disregard for our law, it became an easy decision.
sentences.zh: 国家安全的威胁，看到这些严重的违宪行为、对我们法律的公然蔑视，这就成了一个容易做出的决定。

sentences.en: You know, certainly there will be people in my district who don't support this and across the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的选区和全国各地肯定会有人不支持这一点。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've already heard support from several Republicans in my district who felt like this really was different and this was a line that had been crossed.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我已经在我的选区听到几位共和党人的支持，他们觉得这真的与众不同，这是一条已经被跨越的红线。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I want to be sure I understand the line that you're describing, that you feel, and it sounds
sentences.zh: 我想确保我理解你所描述的那条线，你觉得，听起来

sentences.en: like some of the Republican constituents that you've heard from feel, was so clearly crossed here.
sentences.zh: 像你听到的一些共和党选民也觉得，在这里被如此清晰地跨越了。

sentences.en: The fact that our president is trying to induce a foreign power to threaten our elections, I think that's a huge national security risk.
sentences.zh: 我们的总统试图诱使外国势力来威胁我们的选举，我认为这是一个巨大的国家安全风险。

sentences.en: The fact that a president is withholding support from a security partner that is trying to
sentences.zh: 一个总统扣留对一个安全伙伴的支持，而该伙伴正试图

sentences.en: fight off Russia, which has presented multiple national security threats over the past several
sentences.zh: 击退俄罗斯，俄罗斯在过去几年中提出了多重国家安全威胁，扣留这种支持，明知我们在世界各地威慑俄罗斯侵略

sentences.en: years, to withhold this kind of support, knowing how critical it is that we deter Russian aggression
sentences.zh: 是多么关键，却让这笔援助无法到达我们的安全伙伴手中，

sentences.en: across the world, and to have that aid not arrive to our security partner, not arrive in Ukraine
sentences.zh: 无法在他们试图抵抗这种侵略时到达乌克兰，我只觉得

sentences.en: as they are trying to fight that aggression, I just think it's so incredibly offensive to
sentences.zh: 将这种支持和他们正在进行的战斗置于危险和危急之中是如此令人难以置信地冒犯。

sentences.en: put that kind of support and that kind of fight that they have going on in jeopardy and in peril.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到南希·佩洛西议长在俄罗斯调查之后没有进行弹劾的原因之一，

sentences.en: One of the reasons we understand that Speaker Nancy Pelosi did not pursue impeachment following
sentences.zh: 是她不想危及像你这样的众议院议员。

sentences.en: the Russia investigation is because she did not want to endanger House members such as yourself.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，你站出来帮助佩洛西走到了她现在的位置，即她表示众议院将进行弹劾调查。

sentences.en: It now appears that your coming forward helped lead Pelosi to the place that she's in, where she says that the House will pursue an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 你在站出来之前和佩洛西谈过吗？

sentences.en: Did you speak with Pelosi before you came forward?
sentences.zh: 所以我们整理了我们的专栏文章。

sentences.en: So we put together our op-ed.
sentences.zh: 我们都一直在交谈。

sentences.en: We had all been speaking.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们最终敲定并将其发送给《华盛顿邮报》时，我们打电话给议长说，听着，这就要发表了，这是

sentences.en: And then when we finalized it and sent it to the Washington Post, we called up the speaker to say, look, this will be coming out and this is
sentences.zh: 我们的思考过程，这就是我们这样做的原因。

sentences.en: our thought process and this is why we did this.
sentences.zh: 所以你并不是在寻求许可。

sentences.en: So you weren't really seeking permission.
sentences.zh: 你是在告诉她你要这么做。

sentences.en: You were telling her you were doing it.
sentences.zh: 她说了什么？

sentences.en: What did she say?
sentences.zh: 对，因为我们已经做完了。

sentences.en: Right, because we'd done it.
sentences.zh: 但我们也有，也许是我们的军事背景，我们不喜欢让同单位的其他成员感到意外。

sentences.en: But we also, maybe it's our military background, we don't like to surprise other members of the unit.
sentences.zh: 所以我们把专栏文章寄出去了，然后，你知道的，说我们想坐下来，只是把我们一直在做的事情谈一谈。

sentences.en: So we had sent the op-ed off and then, you know, said we'd like to sit down and just talk through what we've been working on.
sentences.zh: 她说，谢谢你来找我。

sentences.en: And she said, thank you for coming to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个非常强有力的理由。

sentences.en: You know, this is a very strong case.
sentences.zh: 你们确实提出了一些国家安全方面的关键声音，我很感激这一点。

sentences.en: You've really presented some critical voices in national security and I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 那么，你是什么时候意识到她将在某种程度上遵循你的声明、你的领导并支持弹劾调查的想法的？

sentences.en: So when did you realize that she was going to, in a sense, follow your statement, your lead, and back the idea of an impeachment inquiry?
sentences.zh: 我想大概是半小时前吧。

sentences.en: I think about half an hour ago, maybe.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以就在过去一个小时左右。

sentences.en: So just within the last hour or so.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 当她那样做的时候，你怎么想？

sentences.en: And what did you think when she did that?
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们的对话以及她对我们所说的话和我们正在做的事情的反应，我并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I wasn't surprised, given our conversation and her response to what we had said and what we were doing.
sentences.zh: 所以当她出来说，这就是众议院要走的方向时，这似乎是我们昨晚进行的对话合乎逻辑的延续。

sentences.en: So when she came out and said, this is where the House is going, that seemed like a logical continuation of the conversation we'd had last night.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否觉得，正如我们在《时报》的一些同事所感觉的那样，你的声明和这其他六个人的声明产生了非常大的影响。

sentences.en: I wonder if it feels to you, as it does to several of our colleagues here at the Times, that your statement and the statement of these six others made a very big difference.
sentences.zh: 它实际上可能有点打破了僵局。

sentences.en: It may have actually kind of broken the dam.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一份重要的声明。

sentences.en: I think it was an important statement.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们党需要陈述理由。

sentences.en: I think our party needed to lay out the case.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，让这一理由出自一群有为国家服务历史、

sentences.en: And I think to have that case come from a group of people that have a history of service to the
sentences.zh: 没有党派偏见历史的人，我确实认为这是一份很有分量的声明。

sentences.en: country, that don't have a history of being partisan, I do think that was a powerful statement.
sentences.zh: 你说你听取了你选区人们的意见，包括共和党人，但显然现在断定你的选民会对此有何看法还为时过早。

sentences.en: You said you've heard from people in your district, including Republicans, but obviously it's far too early to understand how your voters will come down on this.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这重要吗？

sentences.en: I wonder, does that matter to you?
sentences.zh: 你是否能接受这样一个想法：这个决定理论上可能会让你失去在国会的席位？

sentences.en: Are you comfortable with the idea that this decision could theoretically cost you your seat in Congress?
sentences.zh: 它对我很重要，因为我对这个国家的未来有一个愿景，我认为这很重要，而且我认为这不仅会帮助新泽西人，还会帮助所有美国人。

sentences.en: It matters to me in the sense that I have a vision for the future of this country that I think is important and that I think will help not just New Jerseyans, but all Americans.
